sourceTitle: The Buccaneer Chief: A Romance of the Spanish Main
description: "The Buccaneer Chief: A Romance of the Spanish Main" by Gustave Aimard is a historical novel written in the mid-19th century. The story is set during the 17th century and revolves around the daring exploits of the Count de Barmont, a young naval officer whose ambitions and entanglements in romance and conflict drive the narrative.
